steps.question: When was Mahatma Gandhi born?

questionMeaning.hi: महात्मा गांधी का जन्म कब हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Mahatma Gandhi ka janm kab hua?

steps.modelAnswer: Mahatma Gandhi was born on 2nd October 1869 at Porbandar in Gujarat.

modelMeaning.hi: महात्मा गांधी का जन्म 2 अक्टूबर 1869 को गुजरात के पोरबंदर में हुआ।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mahatma Gandhi ka janm 2 October 1869 ko Gujarat ke Porbandar mein hua.

steps.question: What was his father's name?

questionMeaning.hi: उनके पिता का नाम क्या था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Unke pita ka naam kya tha?

steps.modelAnswer: His father's name was Karamchand Gandhi.

modelMeaning.hi: उनके पिता का नाम करमचंद गांधी था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Unke pita ka naam Karamchand Gandhi tha.

questionMeaning.hi: उनकी माँ का नाम क्या था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Unki maa ka naam kya tha?

modelMeaning.hi: उनकी माँ का नाम पुतलीबाई था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Unki maa ka naam Putlibai tha.

steps.question: When did he go to London?
steps.modelAnswer: He went to London in 1888 to study law.

modelMeaning.hi: वे 1888 में क़ानून पढ़ने लंदन गए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh 1888 mein kaanoon padhne London gaye.

steps.question: Why did he go to South Africa?
options: to work as a lawyer for an Indian company
steps.answer: to work as a lawyer for an Indian company
steps.modelAnswer: He went to South Africa in 1893 to work as a lawyer for an Indian company. There he fought against unfair treatment of Indians.

modelMeaning.hi: वे 1893 में एक भारतीय कंपनी के वकील बनकर दक्षिण अफ़्रीका गए। वहाँ उन्होंने भारतीयों के साथ अन्याय के ख़िलाफ़ लड़ाई लड़ी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh 1893 mein ek Bhaarateeya company ke vakeel bankar Dakshin Africa gaye. Wahan unhone Bhaarateeyon ke saath anyaay ke khilaaf ladaai ladi.
